objective:
TASK: trade segment deep dive.

Pick ONE trade segment from this list that looks least covered (concrete contractors, fence companies, well and pump services, septic services, chimney sweeps, appliance repair): research it across the geography above. Find 12 real businesses in that segment, and for each give: business name, town, website URL (or "no website found"), whether they have online booking or quote forms, Google review count and rating, and one concrete observable weakness or opportunity.
expected_output: numbered list of real, verifiable businesses (>=3 numbered items, >1200 chars). Raw capture is preserved regardless of validation outcome.
